info.title: dotnet-staff
info.description: Provisions Staff-level .NET engineering intelligence into a repository for Claude Code. Run `dotnet staff init`.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: DotNetStaff provisions Staff-level .NET engineering intelligence into a repository for Claude Code.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed progress and reasons. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Only print warnings and errors (for CI). [default: False]

commands.name: init
commands.description: Analyze the repository with your Claude Code and provision skills, rules and CLAUDE.md.

options.name: --path
options.description: Repository directory to operate on. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace DotNetStaff-owned files even when they have local modifications. [default: False]

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Reconcile skills, rules and CLAUDE.md with the repository; analyzes again only when build, infrastructure or structure files changed.

options.name: --path
options.description: Repository directory to operate on. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace DotNetStaff-owned files even when they have local modifications. [default: False]

options.name: --reanalyze
options.description: Analyze again even when the repository has not changed since the last analysis. [default: False]

commands.name: add
commands.description: Install a skill from the catalog as a user-owned skill.

options.name: --path
options.description: Repository directory to operate on. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update installed skills and generated rules to the versions shipped with this tool.

options.name: --path
options.description: Repository directory to operate on. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace DotNetStaff-owned files even when they have local modifications. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the DotNetStaff installation, Claude configuration and security posture.

options.name: --path
options.description: Repository directory to operate on. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: skills
commands.description: List the skills in the catalog.
